messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #90: "[P3][task] Move Baileys logger adapter from core to channel-whatsapp"

## Issue Details
packages/core/src/logger/adapters/baileys.ts contains createBaileysLogger() (lines 113-138) — a Pino-compatible logger adapter specific to WhatsApps Baileys library.

This is channel-specific code in @omni/core, violating plugin isolation. Any package importing @omni/core transitively gains awareness of Baileys, which is a WhatsApp-only dependency.

### Current State
- File at: packages/core/src/logger/adapters/baileys.ts
- Contains createBaileysLogger() and createSilentLogger()
- Only used by WhatsApp plugin
- Not used by core logic itself

### Fix
1. Move baileys.ts to packages/channel-whatsapp/src/utils/baileys-logger.ts
2. Update imports in channel-whatsapp
3. Remove from core exports
4. Verify no other package imports createBaileysLogger from core

### Acceptance Criteria
- baileys.ts lives in channel-whatsapp
- No Baileys references in @omni/core
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
